verdict.rationale: Airwallex's AgentOS toolkit explicitly lets AI agents act on a production account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building reports) and webhooks + APIs provide the building blocks for event-driven automation, but there's no evidence of a native scheduler/trigger system or a documented 'autonomous background automation' feature beyond agent-invoked API calls. missing for 10: evidence of built-in scheduling/triggers for unattended runs, independent/hands-on confirmation that AgentOS-driven automations actually run autonomously without a human-in-the-loop.
